content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Bachelor's degree in business administration/ marketing/ communications, or graduate in any discipline with 5' years experience in the relevant field; MBA (Marketing) with 2 years' experience in the relevant field. Experience required: Previous experience in sales, marketing, advertising, and brand management. The upper age limit is 40 years and the pay is Rs. 40,000 per month. Qualification required: Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Experience required: Experience in different Village industries, MSME, Handicrafts, Cottage etc., or retired officials of KVIC, KVIB, DIC, MSME DI, NSIC and COIR Board not below the rank of Assistant Director. The upper age limit is 65 years and the pay is Rs. 40,000 per month. Qualification required: Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Experience required: 15 years of experience in banking with minimum experience of 3 years as a Branch Manager. The upper age limit is 65 years and the pay is Rs. 40,000 per month for Metro cities or Rs. 25,000 for other cities.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Lump sum consolidated amount. Engaged initially for the FY 2026-27 and may be extended further subject to satisfactory performance, requirement of the office and applicable guidelines/orders of KVIC.

content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications Interview Shortlisted candidates will be informed through e-mail/telephone regarding the date and venue of the interview.

content_sections.text: Experience certificates Attested copy of proof of age Supportive documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KVIC Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format. Attach experience certificates and all other requisite documents. Submit the application through e-mail to [email protected] within 21 days from 01.10.2026. Send it on or before 21 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Decision of the Competent Authority shall be final

content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Khadi and Village Industries Commission, dated 1 October 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KVIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KVIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not state the number of vacancies. It lists 2 places: Kolkata, State Office, KVIC, Kolkata.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KVIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 21 October 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for KVIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for KVIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit depends on the post: 40 for Marketing Expert, 65 for Technical Expert, 65 for Retired/Ex Bank officials.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for KVIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 40,000 per month for Marketing Expert, Rs. 40,000 per month for Technical Expert, Rs. 40,000 per month for Metro cities or Rs. 25,000 for other cities for Retired/Ex Bank officials.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for KVIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Bachelor's degree or MBA or equivalent relevant experience as per post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for KVIC Recruitment 2026 besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Strong written and verbal communication skills of local language of the State besides official language.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for KVIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed through e-mail/telephone regarding the date and venue of the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for KVIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Engaged initially for the FY 2026-27 and may be extended further subject to satisfactory performance, requirement of the office and applicable guidelines/orders of KVIC.
